mapper.sql: emp24_joint_leave_id AS jointLeaveId , emp24_company_id AS companyId , emp24_start_date AS startDate , emp24_close_date AS closeDate , emp24_reason AS reason , emp24_note AS note , emp24_appr_id AS apprId , apr01.apr01_status_cd AS apprStatusCode , f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr01.apr01_status_cd, emp24_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS apprStatusName
mapper.select: SELECT FROM emp24_joint_leave LEFT OUTER JOIN apr01_appr apr01 ON apr01.apr01_appr_id = emp24_appr_id WHERE emp24_company_id = #{companyId} AND (to_char(emp24_start_date, 'yyyy') LIKE #{stdYear} OR to_char(emp24_close_date, 'yyyy') LIKE #{stdYear}) ORDER BY emp24_start_date DESC, emp24_close_date DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO emp24_joint_leave (emp24_joint_leave_id, emp24_company_id, emp24_start_date, emp24_close_date, emp24_reason) VALUES (#{jointLeaveId}, #{companyId}, #{startDate}, #{closeDate}, #{reason})

INSERT INTO apr99_appr_del SELECT f_create_seq() , apr01_appr_id , apr01_title , apr01_reg_date , apr01_status_cd , apr01_content , apr01_note , apr01_reg_emp_id , apr01_effect_date , apr01_class_tree_id , apr01_stamp_id , apr01_receive_nm , apr01_reference_nm , apr01_stamp_seq , apr01_inout_cd , f_sysdate() , #{empId} , apr01_company_id , apr01_form_type , apr01_dcr_id_word , apr01_sign_company , apr01_sign_ceo , apr01_stamp_position , apr01_link_cd FROM apr01_appr WHERE apr01_appr_id = #{apprId}
